business: CAPITALE — software-based football analysis, Instagram account and optional free Telegram channel
target: Adults aged 18–55 in Italy who follow football and watch Instagram Reels; some are interested in statistical match analysis. Simulated profiles are not representative research respondents.
where: Italy (national audience; not tied to a single city)

segments.name: Cautious viewers skeptical of betting promises

behaviours.name: Reels skimmer
behaviours.how: Scrolls fast; watches only if the opening is relevant and clear.

behaviours.name: Statistical explainer viewer
behaviours.how: Follows accounts explaining football data and methodology, not only predictions.

behaviours.name: Trust-first skeptic
behaviours.how: Checks transparency, past losses, methodology and authenticity before following.

behaviours.name: Serie A loyalist
behaviours.how: Mostly consumes analysis of Italian teams and familiar competitions.

behaviours.name: Telegram participant
behaviours.how: Joins niche football channels but leaves when notifications are spammy.

behaviours.name: Privacy-conscious observer
behaviours.how: Avoids unfamiliar links and channels; reads profile carefully before interacting.

objections: Is this a genuine football analysis page or a get-rich-quick promotion?
Are unsuccessful picks and past losses shown as transparently as wins?
Why should I join Telegram instead of reading the Instagram posts?
The profile language is English; is the content relevant to football fans in Italy?
Is following or joining truly free, or will I be pushed into a paid offer?
I do not want gambling encouragement or promises of easy profit.
How does the football analysis software choose matches, and can its claims be verified?
Will the Telegram link expose me to spam or suspicious groups?
habits: you watch short football analysis videos after Serie A matches
you compare football data accounts before deciding which to follow
you read the comments when a video makes numerical performance claims
you rarely click from Instagram to Telegram unless the purpose is clear
you share interesting tactical videos with friends but avoid financial promises
